description_en: Builds a custom image based on the specified configurations. After the build succeeds, the image is added to the custom images of the current workspace
description_zh: 根据指定配置构建自定义镜像， 构建成功后，会添加到当前工作空间的自定义镜像里
name: CreateImageBuild

parameters.help_en:
The visibility. Valid values:
PUBLIC: Public.
PRIVATE: Private
parameters.help_zh:
可见性
PUBLIC 公有
PRIVATE 私有
parameters.name: accessibility

fields.help_en:
The build type. Valid values:
PackageInstallation: Installs software packages based on a specified image.
CustomDockerfile: Uses a custom Dockerfile
fields.help_zh:
构建类型，当前支持以下两种类型：
PackageInstallation ： 基于指定镜像安装软件包。
CustomDockerfile：基于定制 Dockerfile
fields.name: build_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the dataset in the workspace. Example: d-************zbs
fields.help_zh: 工作空间内的数据集 ID。示例值：d-************zbs
fields.name: data_source_id

fields.help_en: The dataset version. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DataSourceId. Example: v1
fields.help_zh: 数据集版本，指定时需要同时指定 DataSourceId。例如：v1
fields.name: data_source_version

fields.help_en: The read and write permissions. Valid values: RW (default) and RO
fields.help_zh: 读写权限："RW"（默认）或 "RO"
fields.name: mount_access

fields.help_en: The mount path. Example: /mnt/data/
fields.help_zh: 挂载路径。例如 /mnt/data/
fields.name: mount_path

fields.help_en: The mount property for the custom dataset. Only OSS is supported. Example: {"fs.oss.download.thread.concurrency":"10"}
fields.help_zh: 自定义数据集挂载属性，目前仅支持 OSS。例如：{"fs.oss.download.thread.concurrency":"10"}
fields.name: options

fields.help_en: The storage path, including the endpoint. This parameter is mutually exclusive with DataSourceId. Example: OSS storage path oss://{bucket-name}.oss-{region}-internal.aliyuncs.com/{subPath}/
fields.help_zh: 存储路径（含 Endpoint），与 DataSourceId 互斥。例如: oss 存储路径 oss://{bucket-name}.oss-{region}-internal.aliyuncs.com/{subPath}/
fields.name: uri

fields.help_en: The list of data sources
fields.help_zh: 数据源列表
fields.name: data_sources

fields.example:
FROM ubuntu:18:04
RUN pip3 install numpy==1.19.5
fields.help_en: The content of the Dockerfile to be built
fields.help_zh: 指定待构建的 Dockerfile 文件内容
fields.name: dockerfile

fields.help_en: The Dockerfile path, which is a relative path to the mounted context path. Example: docker/Dockerfile. If the mount path is /mnt/data/, the file is located at /mnt/data/docker/Dockerfile
fields.help_zh: Dockerfile 文件路径，挂载上下文路径的相对路径。例如：docker/Dockerfile ， 假设挂载路径是 /mnt/data/，文件就位于 /mnt/data/docker/Dockerfile
fields.name: dockerfile_path

fields.help_en: The authentication information for private image repositories. You can specify the authentication information for an ACR image repository that does not belong to the current user. Format: {"user_registry_domain":{"Auth":"base64 encoded auth"}}
fields.help_zh: 私有镜像仓库鉴权信息。可以指定非当前用户的 ACR 镜像仓库的鉴权信息，格式：{"user_registry_domain":{"Auth":"base64 encoded auth"}}
fields.name: registry_auths

parameters.help_en: The build configuration, which specifies the content of the Dockerfile to be built
parameters.help_zh: 构建配置，指定待构建的 Dockerfile 文件内容
parameters.name: build_config

fields.help_en: The image description
fields.help_zh: 镜像描述
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The key of the image label
fields.help_zh: 镜像标签的键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the image label
fields.help_zh: 镜像标签的值
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The image labels
fields.help_zh: 镜像标签
fields.name: labels

fields.help_en:
The image name. The naming rules are as follows:
The name must be 1 to 50 characters in length.
The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-), and must start with a letter.
The name must be unique within the same workspace
fields.help_zh:
命名规则如下：
长度为 1~50 个英文字符。
支持小写字母、数字和短横线（-），以字母开头。
同一工作空间内不可重复
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The image URI
fields.help_zh: 镜像地址
fields.name: uri

parameters.help_en: The name of the image build task
parameters.name: image_build_job_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to overwrite the existing image version in the image repository
parameters.help_zh: 是否覆盖更新镜像仓库中已经存在的镜像版本
parameters.name: overwrite_image_tag

fields.help_en: The pay-as-you-go resource specifications. This parameter is required when you use a public resource group
fields.help_zh: 后付费资源规格。使用“公共资源组”时，此参数必填
fields.name: ecs_spec

fields.help_en: The number of CPU cores
fields.help_zh: CPU 核心数
fields.name: cpu

fields.help_en: The memory capacity
fields.help_zh: 内存容量
fields.name: memory

fields.help_en: The resource configuration. This parameter is required when you use subscription resources and must be left empty when you use a public resource group
fields.help_zh: 资源配置。使用预付费资源时需要指定，使用“公共资源组”时为空
fields.name: resource_config

fields.help_en: The resource quota ID. This parameter applies only to subscription resources and must not be specified when you use pay-as-you-go resources
fields.help_zh: 资源配额 ID。仅针对预付费资源，使用后付费资源时不设置
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The subscription resource type. Only Lingjun resources are supported. This parameter is required when you use subscription resources
fields.help_zh: 预付费资源类型。目前只支持灵骏资源，使用预付费资源时需要指定
fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resources used to run the task
parameters.name: resource

fields.help_en: The registry instance ID. This parameter is required when you use Container Registry (ACR) as the image service
fields.help_zh: 镜像服务实例 ID。 使用 ACR 作为镜像服务时，此参数必填
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The registry type. Only Container Registry Enterprise Edition is supported as the target registry
fields.help_zh: 当前只支持企业版 ACR 作为目标镜像服务
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The default routing of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values:
eth1: Uses the user's elastic network interfaces (ENIs) to access external networks through a private NAT gateway. For the configuration method, refer to Configure a DSW instance to access the Internet through a private NAT gateway (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pai/user-guide/configure-a-dsw-instance-to-access-the-internet-through-a-private-nat-gateway)
fields.help_zh:
默认路由。
eth1：表示使用用户弹性网卡，通过私有网关访问外部网络。具体配置方法，请参考配置 DSW 实例通过专有公网网关访问公网 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/user-guide/configure-a-dsw-instance-to-access-the-internet-through-a-private-nat-gateway?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.3b3965f6SZWm85)
fields.name: default_route

fields.help_en:
The extended CIDR blocks.
If the vSwitch ID is empty, this parameter is optional and the system automatically retrieves all CIDR blocks under the VPC.
If the vSwitch ID is not empty, this parameter is required. We recommend that you specify all CIDR blocks under the VPC
fields.help_zh:
扩展网段。
当交换机 ID 为空时，此参数可以不提供，系统会自动获取 VPC 下的所有网段；
当交换机 ID 不为空时，此参数必须提供，建议填写 VPC 下的所有网段
fields.name: extended_cidrs

fields.help_en: The security group ID. This parameter is required when you specify the VPC configuration
fields.help_zh: 安全组 ID。指定专有网络配置时，此参数必填
fields.name: security_group_id

fields.help_en: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is optional
fields.help_zh: 交换机 ID，可选
fields.name: switch_id

fields.help_en: The VPC ID. When the build task accesses a user's Container Registry Enterprise Edition instance, you must specify a VPC that is added to the access control list of the instance
fields.help_zh: 专有网络 ID。构建任务访问用户企业版 ACR 实例时，需要指定在用户 ACR 实例的访问控制里已添加的专有网络
fields.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The user VPC information. This parameter is required when you use a public resource group
parameters.help_zh: 用户专有网络信息。使用“公共资源组”时，此参数必填
parameters.name: user_vpc

schema.description_en: The response is returned in JSON format
